literal: Compassion joined to those with hearts there is not darkness joined painful world entering.
translation: Those whose hearts are joined with compassion will never enter the painful world of darkness.
modern: அருள் பொருந்திய நெஞ்சத்தை உடையவர்களுக்கு இருள் சூழ்ந்த துன்ப உலகத்தில் நுழையும் நிலை இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet contrasts two states of being: a heart filled with compassion and a world filled with dark suffering. The word 'சேர்ந்த' (joined) is used twice to emphasize this contrast. Those who have joined their hearts with compassion are protected from joining or entering the dark, painful world. The 'dark world' represents a state of ignorance and suffering that naturally follows a lack of empathy.
